rules.statement: A deed of gift creates a fidei commissum residui and possibly a fidei commissum simple if the words 'to deal with the same at will and pleasure' are interpreted to mean that the donee is given the right not only to possess but also to deal with the lands otherwise to the extent of the estate donated.
rules.supporting_quote: "Any apparent repugnancy is eliminated when these words are interpreted to mean that the donee is given the right not only to possess the lands but also the right to deal with them otherwise to the extent of the estate donated to him (in this case the estate of a fidei commissarius)."
